reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate, which every holiday-aware path already calls, and reuses monthUtils.dayFromDate.

duplication.why: Holiday matching remains in one function; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The new isHoliday helper sits in shared/schedules.ts directly under the predicate that uses it, and the format is documented on the RecurConfig type.

scope.why: A helper, a type comment, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A small documented predicate that names both accepted formats.
